newsitem.title: USA: FSA--U.S. terminal market values for grain.
newsitem.headline: FSA--U.S. terminal market values for grain.

text.p: The Farm Service Agency (FSA) established these unit values for commodities offered from government stocks through redemption of Commodity Credit Corp commodity certificates, effective through today. Price per bushel. Sorghum is priced per CWT, corn yellow grade only.
WHEAT HRW HRS SRW SWW DURUM
CORN BARLEY OATS RYE SOYBNS SORG
CORN BRLY OATS RYE SOYB SORG
Note: Amarillo, Kansas City, Evansville, Memphis and Baltimore/Norfolk barley prices discontinued March 3, 1997. Notes on differentials:
--Effective May 27, 1997, LAG and TXG corn and soybean differentials must be adjusted as follows: All differentials add -10 cents.
--Effective May 27, 1997, LAG and TXG sorghum differentials must be adjusted as follows: All differentials add -20 cents/CWT.

--Effective May 27, 1997, differentials for PNW corn should be adjusted as follows -- All differentials add -10 cents. --Effective May 27, 1997, differentials for CHI soybeans should be adjusted as follows -- All differentials add -5 cents.
--Effective Dec 12, 1996, MPL and DUL Spring Wheat differentials must be adjusted as follows: All differentials add -25 cents.
